business_problem: TPBank had modernized its data estate on IBM Cloud Pak for Data, but a digital credit-card acquisition program was still converting below expectations and the bank needed faster, repeatable model-development workflows to turn transaction data into higher-quality leads and broader AI use cases.
solution_summary: TPBank expanded the data platform it had already built on IBM Cloud Pak for Data by using IBM Watson Studio, IBM Watson Machine Learning, IBM Watson Pipelines, and IBM Analytics Engine to operationalize customer propensity modeling. The bank’s data team processed up to 25 GB of structured transactional data through a CRISP-DM workflow covering preparation, feature engineering, model development, and deployment, then used the resulting propensity models inside its digital banking channel to identify credit-card prospects while protecting credit quality. Cloud Pak for Data gives the team a shared foundation for building and deploying data-science assets, and the surrounding Watson components reduce the handoff and operational overhead required to move models into production. Over three years the same platform also helped TPBank build a broader data-fabric capability and scale analytics products across the bank rather than treating each model as a one-off effort.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Pak for Data
solution_components.role: Provides the bank’s shared data and AI platform for model development, deployment, and ongoing analytics modernization.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Studio
solution_components.role: Supports development of the credit-card propensity models used to identify likely prospects.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Machine Learning
solution_components.role: Runs and operationalizes machine learning models for production business use.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Pipelines
solution_components.role: Coordinates the steps needed to prepare data and deploy new models efficiently.

solution_components.name: IBM Analytics Engine
solution_components.role: Contributes analytics processing that helps the bank scale data science use cases across operations.

solution_components.name: IBM Red Hat OpenShift
solution_components.role: Supplies the container platform underpinning the deployed IBM data and AI environment.

data_flow: TPBank ingests up to 25 GB of structured transactional data into Cloud Pak for Data, applies feature engineering and propensity modeling through Watson Studio, Watson Machine Learning, and Watson Pipelines, and then deploys the resulting scores into the bank’s digital channel to target likely credit-card applicants and support broader analytics products.
business_outcome: The bank increased credit-card conversion, shortened model build and deployment cycles, and used the same IBM stack to put more than 15 analytics and machine learning models into production during 2024.
